_about: Look profiles (Technical Artist, 2026-10-08, the grim look test). Switch with F11 in the PSX options overlay (auto, classic, grim). A scene picks its own profile from scene_defaults unless the overlay forced one. 'classic' is the toy-box look Ross approved first and is never changed. 'grim' is the greasy, desaturated, oppressive look from Ross's 2026-10-08 tone decision ('desaturate, darken, grime things up a bit'). Read by scripts/core/look_profiles.gd; every key has a test. grade.* feed the PSX post shader (shaders/psx_post.gdshader); post.* are its color levels and dither size; lighting.* are multipliers on a room's own ambient and lights (PsxRoomLook); fog.* tint and shorten the fog; materials.* drain and darken room material tints (GrimDressing); grime.* are the code-painted grime colors and amounts (GrimePaint); characters.* is the dull, matte, scuffed pass on character textures; models maps a classic model path to this profile's variant; backdrop.* replaces keys of the battle set (BattleBackdrop).

scene_defaults._note: Which profile a scene gets on its own. Keys are room ids (data/world/rooms.json) or 'battle'. Only the look-test scenes are grim for now; everything else stays classic until Ross signs off.

grade._note: amount 1 = fully on. desat drains colour (accent_keep spares bright saturated pixels: lamps, warning stripes, the call's teal). crush/gamma/gain darken. The split tone pushes shadows teal and highlights sodium orange.

player_lamp._note: Red carries her lamp: a small warm light that rides with her in the grim look.
